title: Use Hailuo H3 for the “world is born from a giant brush” creation moment, then…
content: Use Hailuo H3 for the “world is born from a giant brush” creation moment, then switch to Seedance 2.5 for the action sequence where the drawn world starts moving, keeping the same character/story across both models to leverage each model’s strengths in a single short film.
tips: Use Hailuo H3 for the “world is born from a giant brush” creation moment, then switch to Seedance 2.5 for the action sequence where the drawn world starts moving, keeping the same character/story across both models to leverage each model’s strengths in a single short film.

en.content: Use Hailuo H3 for the “world is born from a giant brush” creation moment, then switch to Seedance 2.5 for the action sequence where the drawn world starts moving, keeping the same character/story across both models to leverage each model’s strengths in a single short film.

es.content: Usa Hailuo H3 para el momento de creación de “el mundo nace de un pincel gigante”, y luego cambia a Seedance 2.5 para la secuencia de acción en la que el mundo dibujado empieza a moverse, manteniendo el mismo personaje/historia en ambos modelos para aprovechar las fortalezas de cada uno en un solo cortometraje.

fr.content: Utilisez Hailuo H3 pour le moment de création « le monde naît d’un pinceau géant », puis passez à Seedance 2.5 pour la séquence d’action où le monde dessiné commence à bouger, tout en conservant le même personnage et la même histoire sur les deux modèles afin de tirer parti des points forts de chacun dans un seul court métrage.

ko.content: “Hailuo H3”를 사용해 “거대한 붓에서 세상이 탄생하는” 창조의 순간을 표현한 뒤, 그려진 세계가 움직이기 시작하는 액션 시퀀스에서는 Seedance 2.5로 전환하세요. 두 모델 모두에서 동일한 캐릭터와 스토리를 유지해, 각 모델의 강점을 하나의 짧은 영화 안에서 활용할 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Use o Hailuo H3 para o momento de criação em que “o mundo nasce de um pincel gigante” e, em seguida, mude para o Seedance 2.5 para a sequência de ação em que o mundo desenhado começa a se mover, mantendo o mesmo personagem/história em ambos os modelos para aproveitar os pontos fortes de cada um em um único curta-metragem.

zh.content: 在“世界由一支巨大的画笔诞生”的创作瞬间使用 Hailuo H3，然后切换到 Seedance 2.5 来呈现绘制出的世界开始运动的动作场景，并在两个模型中保持相同的角色/故事，以便在一部短片中充分发挥各自的优势。
